name: City Council Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special Meeting of the City Council, Community
  Development Agency, Community Development Financing
  Authority, Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  August 3, 2011

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Agency, the Community
Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority, and the Library Board of Trustees of the
City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Leckness at 5:01 p.m.,
on August 3, 2011, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on July 29, 2011, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Reardon
  Mayor Pro Tem Ury
  Mayor Leckness

Absent:  Council Member Schlicht

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  W. Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Reardon

INVOCATION: Mayor Leckness

CLOSED SESSION

CS1. Conference with Real Property Negotiator pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.8. Property is an approximate 10.5 acre Site commonly referred to as the
  “Former K Mart” located at 28601 Los Alisos Boulevard and Comprised of
  Assessor Parcel Nos. (APNs) 839-161-08 and 839-161-09 owned by Union Dominion

City Council Minutes  1  August 3, 2011
   Realty/Pacific Los Alisos L.P. (“UDR”.) CDA negotiators: Dennis Wilberg, City
  Manager/CDA Executive Director, Charles Wilson, Director of Community
  Development, James Williams, Economic Advisor, Celeste Brady, CDA Counsel,
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney. Owner’s negotiators: Jeremy Cyr of UDR
  and John Ramirez, Kerra Carlson of Rutan & Tucker, Frank Spevacek of Rosenow
  Spevacek Group, and Peter Whittingham of Curt Pringle Associates, all on behalf
  of UDR. Under negotiation: potential acquisition and/or disposition of real
  property interests for long term affordable housing and the price and terms of
  payment therefore related to the above-listed property. Factors affecting price and
  terms under negotiation: recorded covenants, scope of development of property,
  affordable housing requirements. Factors affecting time of payment: conditions to
  closing, due diligence period, and schedule of development and development of
  affordable housing.

CS2. Conference with Real Property Negotiator pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.8. Property is an approximate 7.126 acre Site, APN 761-072-01 with a
  common street address of 26742 Oso Parkway, Mission Viejo, California owned by
  Mission Viejo Oso Parkway Development, LP, a California limited partnership
  (“Watermarke”). CDA negotiators: Dennis Wilberg, City Manager/CDA Executive
  Director, Charles Wilson, Director of Community Development, James Williams,
  Economic Advisor, Celeste Brady, CDA Counsel, William P. Curley III, City
  Attorney. Owner’s negotiators: Greg Neville of Watermarke and Jeffrey Oderman
  of Rutan & Tucker. Under negotiation: potential acquisition and/or disposition of
  real property interests for long term affordable housing and the price and terms of
  payment therefore related to the above-listed property. Factors affecting price and
  terms under negotiation: recorded covenants, scope of development of property,
  affordable housing requirements. Factors affecting time of payment: conditions to
  closing, due diligence period, and schedule of development and development of
  affordable housing.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:03 p.m., Mayor Leckness recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City
Council reconvened at 6:02 p.m. with four City Council Members present (Council Member
Schlicht was absent.)

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that City Council provided direction to staff in Closed
Session but there was no reportable action.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Dan Avery, M.V.: thanked the City Council for a wonderful evening on July 30 at the Pacific

City Council Minutes  2  August 3, 2011
 Symphony. He expressed special gratitude to City staff, the volunteers, and members of the
Community Services Commission for their hard work that evening.

OPEN SESSION

1.  City Council Resolution Declaring Its Intention to Enact an Ordinance Whereby the
  City Shall Elect To Comply With and Participate in the Alternative Voluntary
  Redevelopment Program Contained in Part 1.9 of Division 24 of the California
  Health and Safety Code; and Introduction of City Ordinance Electing to Comply
  With and Participate in the Alternative Voluntary Redevelopment Program
  Contained in Part 1.9 of Division 24 of the California Health and Safety Code

  Special Counsel Celeste Brady, Stradling Yocca Carlson and Rauth, presented the staff
  report and outlined the options available to the City Council under Assembly Bills X1 26
  and X1 27.

  Dorothy Wedel, M.V.: expressed concerned about the use and misuse of redevelopment
  monies.

  City Manager Dennis Wilberg and Director of Administrative Services Cheryl Dyas
  answered questions of the City Council.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, seconded by Mayor Leckness, to adopt Resolution
  11-49 Declaring Intention to Enact an Ordinance Whereby the City Shall Elect to
  Comply With and Participate in the Alternative Voluntary Redevelopment Program
  Contained in Part 1.9 of Division 24 of the California Health and Safety Code.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness and Ury
  NOES:  Reardon
  ABSENT:  Schlicht

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, seconded by Mayor Leckness, to introduce and
  conduct first reading of City Ordinance 11-291 Electing to Comply With and Participate
  in the Alternative Voluntary Redevelopment Program Contained in Part 1.9 of Division
  24 of the California Health and Safety Code.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness and Ury
  NOES:  Reardon
  ABSENT:  Schlicht

City Council Minutes  3  August 3, 2011
 ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 7:30 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Leckness adjourned the meeting to Monday, August 15, 2011, at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of August 15, 2011
